entities.name: Brago, King Eternal
entities.description: The King Eternal who ruled the High City of Paliano on Fiora; after his death his spirit was kept as a figurehead and was later eliminated by Kaya.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The High City on the plane of Fiora ruled by Brago.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane on which the High City of Paliano stands.

entities.name: The Custodi
entities.description: The priesthood that kept Brago's spirit as a figurehead to retain their command.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who eliminated Brago's spirit.

entities.name: Queen Marchesa
entities.description: The Black Rose, who confiscated the throne of Paliano and issued a proclamation as queen.

entities.name: Captain Adriana
entities.description: A captain who gave a revolutionary speech and later a response to Marchesa's proclamation.

events.summary: Brago ruled Paliano on Fiora; after he died the Custodi kept his spirit as a figurehead to retain their command.
events.quote: kept his spirit as a figurehead and were able to retain their command for a while.

events.summary: Kaya eliminates Brago's spirit and the Black Rose confiscates the throne.
events.quote: The Black Rose confiscated the throne after Brago's spirit was eliminated by the planeswalker Kaya

events.summary: Queen Marchesa issues a proclamation and Captain Adriana answers it with a revolutionary speech.
events.quote: a revolutionary speech by Captain Adriana

relations.quote: Brago's spirit was eliminated by the planeswalker Kaya
the King Eternal ruled the High City of Paliano on the plane of Fiora

relations.note: Paliano is on the plane of Fiora.
relations.quote: the High City of Paliano on the plane of Fiora

relations.note: Marchesa's proclamation and Adriana's revolutionary response are opposed.
relations.quote: a proclamation by Her Majesty Queen Marchesa
